author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/10/2018: CLS, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, NVDA
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.44%
AAPL: -0.41%
IBM: -0.10%
CSCO: -0.38%
GOOG: -0.55%
Technology stocks were falling in early Wednesday trading.
Sector news includes:
(=) Celestica ( CLS ), which was halted for nearly 20 minutes and resumed pre-market trading at 7:18 am ET as the company unveiled a definitive agreement to acquire Impakt Holdings, provider of manufacturing solutions, for $329 million.
(-) Nvidia ( NVDA ) was trading 0.82% lower after announcing that Volvo has selected the Nvidia Drive AGX Xavier computer for its next-generation vehicles, with production starting early 2020s.
